newsitem.title: USA: Westcoast sees B.C. gas plant back Friday.
newsitem.headline: Westcoast sees B.C. gas plant back Friday.

text.p: Westcoast Energy said it expects to reopen its Fort Nelson, British Columbia, natural gas processing plant late Friday.
"We expect to be restarting at 10 PM (2200 PDT) tonight," Rainer Malcharek, area manager for Fort Nelson Field Services, told Reuters.

The 750 million cubic feet per day (mmcfd) plant restarted at 2100 PDT but was shut the following morning at 0600 PDT and force majeure was declared because of problems with the quality of the gas being delivered to the plant, he said.
The plant has been shut for scheduled maintenance since June 10.
Following news of the force majeure, prices at the AECO storage hub gained about five cents to C$1.64-1.65 per gigajoule.
